newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends up vs dlr, yen and lira futures drop.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends up vs dlr, yen and lira futures drop.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed Tuesday's interbank forex market firmer against the dollar as it followed movements on international markets, dealers said
The forint closed at 155.33/38 against the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 155.44/49.
"The afternoon session was more animated, but overall, it was an average day," said Peter Benda of Citibank.
The forint remained close to the central bank bid, except for an insubstantial four fillers gap in early trade.
